objective: Replace challenge-specific runtime function/method overwrites with explicit stable rule selection while retaining modes 0–3, challenge save isolation and foreground/Worker predictor parity.

include: Central mode-selected policy and stable global/Action function references
Exact legacy economy, combat, speed, visibility and restart behavior
Regression fixtures for all transitions, saves, import/reload, worker parity
exclude: Real World timeline variants or potion/outer-loop gameplay
New save schema, balance changes, action moves, new framework, deployment or merge

acceptance_criteria: A1: Frozen normal/challenge gameplay baseline values and outcomes match
A2: Global restart/combat and affected Action method identities remain stable
A3: Normal/challenge saves and RF02 recovery/overwrite/resume/exit semantics are preserved
A4: Mode 1 gold/mana/merchant and visibility behavior matches including limits
A5: Mode 2 combat formulas match for zero/nonzero members and modifiers
A6: Mode 3 preserves the original restart formula, including non-positive values, with characterized queue/timer/lifecycle boundaries (RF04-Q03 A)
A7: Foreground and Worker prediction use mode-aware parity with snapshot/cache correctness
A8: Three mode transition cycles, save/import/reload/resume and regression suites pass
constraints: Preserve AGENTS.md and legacy Orcha authority; no stage acceptance by file status
Preserve ILSV01, idleLoops1/idleLoopsChallenge and RF02 recovery journal
No new game mode, balance adjustment, migration, auto-merge, deployment or host activation
Do not claim unrun browser/Node/CI checks passed
